user.title: Connect to Larder
user.description: Using the Larder add-on? It sets itself up: look for it under Discovered. For Larder running elsewhere, enter its address and an access token made in Larder under Settings → Access tokens.

hassio_confirm.title: Larder add-on
hassio_confirm.description: Connect Home Assistant to the Larder add-on? You'll get sensors for what's running low, what to use soon and what's out of place, plus Larder actions and events.

reauth_confirm.title: New access token
reauth_confirm.description: Larder at {url} no longer accepts the access token. Make a new one in Larder under Settings → Access tokens.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Larder at that address. Check it's running and the address and port are right.
error.invalid_auth: Larder didn't accept that access token. Make a new one in Larder under Settings → Access tokens.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.cannot_connect: Can't reach the Larder add-on. Check it's started.
abort.invalid_auth: The Larder add-on's token was refused. Restart the add-on to make a new one.
abort.wrong_larder: That address is a different Larder. Add it separately instead.

data.forward_tags: Send NFC tag scans to Larder

data_description.battery_threshold: When a device's battery drops below this, Larder says whether there's a spare.
data_description.forward_tags: Tags scanned with the Home Assistant app are sent to Larder, which fires larder_nfc_scanned with the product or place.
